messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for cont-batch-usw2 - p99 latency jump above configured SLO. auto-paging to #eng-oncall. severity: sev2. p95: 190ms -> 420ms, p99: 320ms -> 1.9s. incidents log id: INC-1789994321

sara: oncall here, acknowledging. seeing same in console. tagging runtime + infra: @lee @matt can you look?

lee: looking now. initial cursory: cont-batch pool 'usw2-prod-cont' showing increased tail latency and streaming stalls on nodes hosting mixedlen workloads. traces show KV cache churn and large batches blocking small seqs.

matt: grabbing kube logs and metrics. any customer reports?

customer-ops: Appify reported failed requests and degraded UX. they see ~12% error increase and slow chats around 18:23 UTC. Notified CSM.

anjali: posting quick metrics: 
- baseline p95=120ms p99=300ms
- now p95~190-420ms depending on route, p99 spikes up to ~1.9s
- streaming stall count (stall>200ms) up x6
- avg batch size climbed from 6 -> 18 on cont-batch due to a few long sequences (seq_len>2048)

lee: hypothesis: continuous batching scheduler is letting big sequences pack and occupy the batching window, starving small short requests — padding amplification + mixed sequence length causing packing oscillation. also KV cache eviction when new large seqs touch many keys causing page faults.

sara: customers impacted = Appify (production). severity escalate if more customers show errors. mitigation options?

matt: immediate mitigations we can try (low risk):
1) route short requests to dedicated smallseq pool (dedicated-smallseq-1) as fallback for 10m.
2) reduce max_batch_size or add max_latency_ms cap for cont-batch-usw2 (e.g., set max_batch_size=8, max_wait_ms=10ms)
3) enable preemptive packing: allow small requests to preempt large batch formation (scheduler flag)

lee: agree. we should also throttle long-sequence-heavy customers temporarily to reduce packing pressure.

anjali: propose quick command to add fallback route for the API route 'chat.generate':
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/routes/update" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"chat.generate.cont-batch-usw2","fallback":"dedicated-smallseq-1","ttl_seconds":600}'
```

matt: i'll run the route change. will also reduce max_batch_size on cont-batch pool via rlctl: `rlctl patch scheduler cont-batch-usw2 --set max_batch_size=8 --set max_wait_ms=10`

ops-bot: Deploy triggered: route update job queued (job id: job-1789994321-1). Approving? :eyes:

sara: approve. start mitigation now.

matt: route update applied and scheduler patch sent. verification:
- rolling config update to 6 nodes succeeded
- fallback route active for chat.generate -> dedicated-smallseq-1

lee: metrics post-mitigation (2m after): p95 down to ~160ms, p99 ~420ms, streaming stalls reduced by ~45%. still above baseline but much improved.

customer-ops: Appify reporting improved performance after 3 minutes, errors down to ~3%. CSM updated.

lee: traceback shows a single customer workload (internal-research-7) started long-seq batch storms around 18:20 UTC — lots of multimodal long contexts. we throttled them on dedicated pool now. their requests introduce large KV footprints and cause eviction thrash.

anjali: opened follow-up issue: RED-INC-1789994321 - cont-batch tail due to mixedlen packing. assigning to lee/runtime. includes: add metrics for per-customer batch size distribution, patch scheduler fairness test, ensure KV eviction smoothing.

lee: immediate postmortem actions I want:
- instrument per-request sequence length histogram in prom (already queued)
- enhance scheduler fairness: add weighted fair-share that protects short requests from being starved by top-K long requests
- add preemptive small-request bypass for streaming endpoints (if small_seq_len < 128)

matt: infra tasks:
- add temporary node label 'no-longseq' for smallpool nodes
- tune KV cache eviction threshold to be less aggressive for cont-batch pool (avoid thrash)
- run a canary with synthetic mixedlen traffic to validate fairness change

sara: handoff: lee owns follow-up, matt owns infra changes, anjali will own customer comms / postmortem draft. we will reconvene on the postmortem channel in 24h.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1789994321 updated -> mitigated, severity downgraded to sev3. Automated postmortem task created: PM-1789994321.

sara: monitoring for additional regressions for 30m, if stable we'll close. thanks team. :thumbsup:

lee: quick note for follow-up engineer: consider adding a 'max_tokens_chunk' option to the batcher so very long sequences are split earlier into multiple smaller batches to reduce packing impact.

matt: saved config snippets and logs to /var/logs/contbatch/INC-1789994321 and uploaded profiling traces to s3://redwood-incidents/1789994321/traces.tar.gz

anjali: creating customer update thread to Appify and internal RCA draft now.

sara: closing loop: will file postmortem w/ timeline, mitigation steps, and long-term fixes. if anyone sees new spikes ping here.

ops-bot: Monitoring alert cleared for cont-batch-usw2 p99 after 12m.

sara: closing thread at 18:34 UTC. follow-ups tracked in RED-INC-1789994321 and PM-1789994321.
